wro_001: You can recognise it by its hollow, thick trunk on the open riverside boulevard. It stands beside the Oder canal, between the Zwierzyniecki and Szczytnicki bridges.
wro_002: You can recognise it by its very wide trunk under a low crown, its branches held together with steel bindings and clamps. It stands on the pavement of ul. Kopernika, in front of the training centre.
wro_003: You can recognise it by its large, well-formed crown, standing sound with no bracing, unlike its neighbours. It stands on ul. Wroblewskiego, a few minutes from the zoo entrance.
wro_004: You can recognise it by its tall crown, damaged by a past lightning strike, still holding leaves. It stands in Park Szczytnicki, near the narrowing of the park pond, a few minutes from Hala Stulecia.
wro_005: You can recognise it by the fountain and its two bronze statues standing right beside it, one of a man wrestling a lion. It stands on Plac Jana Pawla II, near the Civil Registry Office.
